provenance_note: Hand-derived from 131.0-B-6 10.2.1, 10.3.2, 10.3.3, 10.4.1, 10.4.3 and its note 2. Model test-vectors/models/sync.py, written blind (TV-023) by a Claude agent from the Blue Books and docs/ only, without reading any implementation; for format only it read the existing models (cop1.py, link_recv.py) and the vector schemas. The inputs were chosen by hand; the expected values are the model's, whose sequences it checks against the 40-bit notes of 131.0-B-6 10.4.3 (note 2) and whose search engine it checks against a second, offline formulation. Where the documents are silent the model refuses the case (README of test-vectors/sync/). The file is written by the model (--write) and never edited by hand.

cases.description: Five zero octets give the first 40 bits of the sequence, the bits of the note of 131.0 10.4.3 (note 2).
An empty buffer is accepted and stays empty (SYNC-004).

Data octets are exclusive-ORed bit for bit with the sequence.
Applying the function to the output of sync-rand-131071-data restores the data: one function for both directions (10.3.3).
An all-ones buffer gives the complement of the sequence.
16383 zero octets: the buffer ends 7 bits before the end of the first period.
16384 zero octets: the buffer ends one bit after the first period; the last octet holds the last bit of the period and the first 7 bits of the next.
16385 zero octets: the buffer is one octet past the first period.
32768 zero octets: the buffer holds two full periods and 2 bits, so the sequence repeats at a bit that is not an octet boundary (10.4.3).
A 65536-octet unit of zeros: 524288 bits, four periods and 4 bits, the largest frame of AOS and USLP (11.3).
20000 data octets, across the end of the first period.
